product_one_liner.value: Authenticate is an identity-verification and background-screening platform for businesses that verifies people and checks records such as criminal, driving, employment, and education records to help reduce fraud.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes the platform as verifying a person’s identity and checking criminal, driving, employment, and education records. The homepage frames these solutions for businesses seeking to verify users and prevent fraud.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage includes a public pricing section with named verification services and prices, so a public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The IaaS launch article describes RunnerCity and NotaryHub.com by Everything Legal as customers and includes customer statements about their use of Authenticate. | named_customers.0: The article identifies RunnerCity as a customer and includes customer statements about Authenticate. | named_customers.1: The article identifies NotaryHub.com by Everything Legal as a customer and includes its CEO’s statement about Authenticate.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 13 employees, which falls in the 11–20 band. Another size indicator on the profile is not identical, so confidence is medium.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile lists Park City, Utah as its locality and primary location. Because the profile does not explicitly label this as headquarters and other sources list Santa Monica, this is a medium-confidence best-supported location. | hq_country: The company profile identifies Park City, Utah as its locality and gives a primary location there in the United States. Other sources list Santa Monica, so the location is not unambiguous; this reflects the company profile’s listed primary location rather than a clearly stated headquarters label.

founded_year.notes: The company’s LinkedIn profile lists 2018 as its founded year. A company-data profile listed 2017, so I used the company profile and assign medium confidence because the sources conflict.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents general news, updates, and resources about identity verification and related products. It does not establish at least two engineering-authored posts about how the product is built, so this is not an engineering blog under the requested criteria.

public_docs.notes: Authenticate has a public Developer Hub with guides and API reference, and its public Knowledge Base lists multiple getting-started, product, and FAQ articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page says jobs open from time to time and asks visitors to check again soon, indicating no current openings.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed developer documentation, privacy-policy material, and security material do not identify an AI model or provider used by the product. The company discusses technology and cloud services, but those do not establish a model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The compliance FAQ names SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and GDPR. ISO 27001 is not included because the cited page does not name it. | compliance_certs.0: The compliance FAQ names SOC 2 Type 2. | compliance_certs.1: The compliance FAQ names HIPAA compliance. | compliance_certs.2: The compliance FAQ names GDPR compliance. | compliance_certs.3: The compliance FAQ names PCI DSS compliance.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The company-data profile marks Authenticate as unfunded and reports an empty funding-round history; the stage is therefore none. | funding_date: The company-data profile reports no funding rounds and no latest funding date, so there is no date to report. | funding_amount_usd: The company-data profile lists Authenticate as unfunded and shows no funding rounds, so there is no most-recent-round amount to report.

raised_18mo.notes: The company-data profile indicates no funding rounds and an unfunded status, supporting a false answer for whether it raised funding during the preceding 18 months.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page indicates there are no current openings, so there is no current SDR, BDR, or account-executive hiring.

launched_6mo.notes: The dated ReAuthenticate article (30 June 2026) discusses the feature and its security benefits but does not announce a launch. The company’s visible July and October 2026 posts are not identified as product launches. No launch-type announcement in the six-month window was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available profile material does not provide a complete, dated C-level or VP roster or a verifiable departure record for the period. There is not enough evidence to conclude either that such a change occurred or that none occurred.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The privacy policy names Salesforce and HubSpot as data providers it may use to supplement information provided by business customers. The wording is conditional, so this identifies a visible signal rather than proving active use. | crm_stack_signal.0: The privacy policy names Salesforce among possible business-customer data providers. | crm_stack_signal.1: The privacy policy names HubSpot among possible business-customer data providers.
